authority: diagnostic: paper only, not investment advice
flags: Newmont and Barrick amended the Nevada Gold Mines joint venture. Newmont agreed to contribute $1.95 billion in cash within 30 days after the Fourmile property is contributed. That contribution had not yet taken place at the 10-Q date.
Operations at the Cadia mine were temporarily suspended after seismic activity was recorded near the operation.

Ghana's Parliament enacted legislation, effective early March 2026, replacing the fixed 5% gold royalty with a sliding scale of 5% to 12%. It also cut the Growth and Sustainability Levy to 1%, effective April 1, 2026.
no_value_reason: too little filed history (fewer than 3 fiscal years, or no revenue in SEC's company facts)

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 business description.
business_model.claim: Newmont is primarily a gold miner. It also produces copper, silver, lead and zinc, and it operates in many countries across several continents.
quotes: Newmont is also engaged in the production of copper, silver, lead, and zinc.

business_model.basis: Stated: the percentage is in P1 and the dollar split is in the P3 sales table.
business_model.claim: Gold is the dominant revenue line. In the latest annual report it was 85% of Sales, with gold Sales of $19,304 out of total Sales of $22,669 (table in millions).
quotes: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, 85%, 85% and 89%, respectively, of our Sales were attributable to gold.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q sales table and income statement.
business_model.claim: In the latest nine months, Sales were $19,788 (table in millions). By metal they were gold $16,540, silver $1,552, copper $985, zinc $588 and lead $123 (table in millions).

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 business description; the customer-dependence point is only a cross-reference.
business_model.claim: Newmont sells doré through refiners and sells metal concentrates to smelters. The evidence names no individual customers, and the 10-K points to a note on lack of dependence on a limited number of customers.
quotes: Doré is sent to refiners to produce bullion that meets the required market standard of 99.95% gold.
Copper, silver, lead, and zinc sales are generally in the form of concentrate that is sold to smelters for further treatment and refining.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 segment description and product table.
business_model.claim: Reporting is organised by mine. There are 13 segments: 12 operations Newmont manages, plus its 38.5% proportionate interest in Nevada Gold Mines (NGM), which it does not directly manage. The managed operations are Lihir, Cadia, Tanami, Boddington, Ahafo South, Ahafo North, Merian, Cerro Negro, Yanacocha, Peñasquito, Red Chris and Brucejack.
quotes: The Company's 13 reportable segments consist of each of its 12 mining operations that it manages

business_model.basis: Stated in the MD&A and in the press-release operating table.
business_model.claim: Revenue moves mainly with realized metal prices and ounces sold. In the latest quarter the average realized gold price was $4,317 versus $3,539 a year earlier, and gold ounces sold were 1,211 versus 1,319 (thousand ounces). Sales rose to $6,363 from $5,524 (table in millions) because price outweighed volume.
quotes: largely reflecting higher average realized gold and silver prices partially offset by lower sales volumes for gold

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1A risk factors; the 10-Q reports no material change to these risks.
business_model.claim: Newmont does not hedge its metal sales, so realized price changes flow straight into revenue, net income and operating cash flow.
quotes: Any decline in our realized prices adversely impacts our revenues, net income and operating cash flows, particularly in light of our strategy of not engaging in hedging transactions with respect to sales of gold, copper, silver, lead or zinc.

business_model.basis: Stated in the release's assumptions and sensitivities table.
business_model.claim: The company's own 2026 sensitivity table shows gold as the largest revenue driver. Its assumption of $4,500 per ounce with a $100 change carries a $505 revenue and cost impact (table in $M). The next largest listed sensitivity is the Australian dollar at $100.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K Item 1 co-product table and by-product definition.
business_model.claim: Copper, silver, lead and zinc are co-products at some mines and add revenue beyond gold. In the latest fiscal year they were 6% (copper), 5% (silver), 1% (lead) and 3% (zinc) of Sales. At other mines they are by-products, and their revenue is credited against Costs applicable to sales instead.
quotes: Revenues from by-product sales are credited to Costs applicable to sales in the Consolidated Financial Statements.

business_model.claim: In the latest nine months, Costs applicable to sales were 6,168, depreciation and amortization 1,868, and total costs and expenses 9,063 (table in millions). A year earlier these were 6,058, 1,856 and 7,958. Costs applicable to sales therefore grew much less than Sales.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K risk factors and the Q3 release.
business_model.claim: Costs depend on input prices (fuel, power, labor, reagents, explosives, steel), on ore grade and on inflation. Newmont now gives an oil sensitivity of about $50 million additional cost per $10 move in the oil price for indirect exposure, plus a direct impact of $60 (table in $M).
quotes: In addition, costs are affected by the price and availability of input commodities, such as fuel, electricity, labor, chemical reagents, explosives, steel, concrete and mining and processing related equipment and facilities.
which is expected to result in an additional approximate $50 million cost impact for every $10 change in price per barrel of oil

business_model.basis: Stated in the Q3 earnings release; the cause of the Q4 increase is management's own explanation.
business_model.claim: The company tracks unit costs per gold ounce. Latest-quarter gold by-product Costs Applicable to Sales were $832 per ounce and All-In Sustaining Costs were $1,454 per ounce. Full-year guidance was improved to $925 and $1,520, but Q4 unit costs are expected to rise.
quotes: unit costs are expected to increase in the fourth quarter primarily due to higher sustaining capital spend, as well as lower co-product volumes

business_model.claim: Government take is a major cost driver and changes with policy. In Ghana, royalties moved to a sliding scale of 5% to 12% of gold revenue linked to the gold price, which can raise costs when prices are high.
quotes: Subsequently, the Parliament of Ghana enacted legislation, effective early March 2026, revising the royalty framework to a sliding-scale structure ranging from 5% to 12% of gold revenues, based on prevailing gold prices.

business_model.basis: Stated in the income statement and the cash flow footnote.
business_model.claim: Income and mining taxes take a large share of earnings. Over the latest nine months, tax expense was 3,195 against pre-tax income of 10,792 (table in millions). Net cash paid for income and mining taxes was $3,207 versus $1,701 a year earlier.
quotes: Includes $3,207 and $1,701 of cash payments for income and mining taxes, net of refunds

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K and the 10-Q MD&A.
business_model.claim: A material part of the portfolio is a joint venture run by a partner. Barrick operates Nevada Gold Mines, in which Newmont holds 38.5%. An amended agreement contributes extra development properties to NGM, and Newmont agreed to pay $1.95 billion in cash after Fourmile is contributed.
quotes: Barrick operates NGM with overall management responsibility
The Company also agreed to contribute $1.95 billion in cash within 30 days following the contribution of the Fourmile development property.

business_model.basis: Stated for the amounts. That these affiliates drive the equity income is inferred from the 10-K's equity-method disclosure, since the 10-Q note is not in the packet.
business_model.claim: Equity-accounted affiliates add earnings outside consolidated Sales. Equity income of affiliates was 496 in the latest nine months versus 250 a year earlier (table in millions). The affiliates include Pueblo Viejo (40%) and Lundin Gold (32%), and Lundin Gold is reported on a quarterly lag.
quotes: which is accounted for as an equity method investment on a quarterly lag

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-K MD&A and Item 1.
business_model.claim: Volume has been reduced by the sale of non-core mines. Attributable gold production was 5,889 thousand ounces in the latest fiscal year versus 6,849 the year before. The divested sites cut annual Sales by $2,254 (table in millions).
quotes: Included in the change in Sales is the impact relating to the divested sites which resulted in a decrease of $2,254 for the year ended 2025 compared to 2024.

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A and in the release's operating table.
business_model.claim: Operating disruptions at a single mine can move volume. Cadia was temporarily suspended after seismic activity, and its attributable gold production was 34 thousand ounces in the second quarter versus 104 in the same quarter a year earlier.
quotes: operations at Cadia were temporarily suspended following seismic activity recorded near the operation on April 14, 2026

business_model.basis: Stated in the 10-Q cash flow statement.
business_model.claim: The business converts mining profit into cash, much of which is returned to shareholders. In the latest nine months, operating cash flow was 9,477 and capital additions were 2,216. Repurchases of common stock were 5,241 and dividends paid were 831 (table in millions).

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the cited item (company self-assessment, not independently verified in the evidence).
competitive_position.claim: Newmont describes itself as the top gold producer, with about 5% of estimated worldwide mined gold production. The top 10 producers together account for about 25%.
quotes: We currently rank as the top gold producer with approximately 5% of estimated total worldwide mined gold production.

competitive_position.claim: The asset base is large and diversified by geography and metal. Attributable proven and probable gold reserves were 118.2 million ounces at the last year-end, and the company has co-product copper, silver, lead and zinc.
quotes: Newmont had attributable proven and probable gold reserves of 118.2 million ounces

competitive_position.claim: Recent financial results are strong. Nine-month sales rose to 19,788 from 15,851, and net income attributable to Newmont stockholders rose to 7,939 from 5,784 (tables in millions). At quarter-end cash was 8,827 against debt of 5,087 (table in millions).

Earnings growth is driven by price rather than volume. The third-quarter average realized gold price was $4,317 per ounce against $3,539 a year earlier, while consolidated gold ounces sold fell to 1,211 thousand from 1,319 thousand.
quotes: a net increase in Sales, largely reflecting higher average realized gold and silver prices partially offset by lower sales volumes for gold

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the cited items. The table reports the figure in $M.
competitive_position.claim: Revenue is exposed to metal prices without hedging. Guidance assumes gold at $4,500 per ounce, and a $100 change carries a revenue and cost impact of $505 (table in millions).
quotes: Any decline in our realized prices adversely impacts our revenues, net income and operating cash flows, particularly in light of our strategy of not engaging in hedging transactions with respect to sales of gold, copper, silver, lead or zinc.

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the cited release. The comparison is read directly from its table.
competitive_position.claim: Unit costs are rising and are expected to keep rising. Third-quarter gold co-product AISC was $1,963 per ounce against $1,566 a year earlier, and by-product AISC was $1,454 against $1,303. Management expects unit costs to trend higher next year.
quotes: Newmont expects unit costs to trend higher in 2027 reflecting inflation escalation above the 3 percent assumption incorporated for 2026 guidance

competitive_position.claim: Host-government fiscal terms are a threat in Ghana. Ghana's royalty moved to a sliding scale of 5% to 12% of gold revenues, which could raise operating costs at its Ghanaian operations, especially at higher gold prices.
quotes: Subsequently, the Parliament of Ghana enacted legislation, effective early March 2026, revising the royalty framework to a sliding-scale structure ranging from 5% to 12% of gold revenues, based on prevailing gold prices.

competitive_position.claim: A large part of the portfolio sits in Nevada Gold Mines, in which Newmont holds 38.5% and does not directly manage. This creates counterparty risk. An earlier dispute with Barrick was resolved by an amended agreement that requires Newmont to contribute $1.95 billion in cash.
quotes: The agreement also includes enhancements to the governance provisions of the NGM joint venture, resolves all outstanding disputes between the Company and Barrick relating to NGM

competitive_position.basis: Stated in the cited items (the production figures are table values).
competitive_position.claim: Production is shrinking after the divestments, and an operating disruption has added to the decline. Attributable gold production was 5,889 thousand ounces in the last fiscal year against 6,849 in the prior year. Cadia output was 34 thousand ounces in the second quarter against 104 a year earlier, after seismic activity in April led to a temporary suspension.
quotes: operations at Cadia were temporarily suspended following seismic activity recorded near the operation on April 14, 2026

competitive_position.claim: The company is using its cash flow to shrink the share count. Nine-month repurchases were 5,241 and dividends were 831 (table in millions), against operating cash flow of 9,477 (table in millions). Management says the share count has fallen by over 115 million shares, or approximately 10 percent, since February 2024.
quotes: Since February 2024, Newmont has reduced its share count by over 115 million shares, or approximately 10 percent of shares outstanding

competitive_position.claim: Long-dated environmental obligations are a structural threat to competitive position. Reclamation and remediation liabilities were 6,095 on the balance sheet (table in millions), and management warns of possible material increases at Yanacocha.
quotes: These and other risks and contingencies that are the subject of ongoing studies could result in future material increases to the reclamation obligation at Yanacocha

financial_health.claim: Liquidity is large against near-term obligations. Cash and cash equivalents were 8,827 (table in millions) at the latest quarter-end, up from 7,647 at the prior year-end. Current assets of 13,571 exceed current liabilities of 5,539 (table in millions).
Management reports total liquidity of $12.8 billion, which includes $4.0 billion available on a revolving credit facility.
quotes: Total liquidity as of September 30, 2026 includes $4.0 billion available on a revolving credit facility.

financial_health.basis: stated in P6 net-debt reconciliation and balance sheet F1
financial_health.claim: Leverage is low. The company reports a net cash position of $3.2 billion, and the only debt line on the balance sheet is non-current Debt of 5,087 (table in millions), which is below cash.
quotes: Ended the quarter with $8.8 billion of cash and $12.8 billion in total liquidity6, with a net cash position of $3.2 billion3

financial_health.basis: stated in the cash flow statement (F3) and income statement (F2)
financial_health.claim: Debt has been cut sharply and repayments this year have been minimal. Year-to-date repayment of debt was (39) against (3,360) a year earlier (table in millions), and net interest expense fell to (105) from (196).

Long-dated non-debt obligations are sizeable. Non-current reclamation and remediation liabilities are 6,095 (table in millions), above debt of 5,087, and operating cash flow includes a (714) outflow for reclamation and remediation liabilities year to date.

financial_health.basis: stated in F3; free cash flow figure stated in P6 (non-GAAP)
financial_health.claim: Cash generation is strong. Operating cash flow was 9,477 year to date versus 6,713 a year earlier, after additions to property, plant and mine development of (2,216). The company reports non-GAAP free cash flow of $7,261 year to date (table in millions).

Working capital reduced reported cash flow. Cash from operations before working capital was 10,334 year to date against net operating cash flow of 9,477, because changes in operating assets and liabilities absorbed (857). In the third quarter the working capital drag was $565 million, and management says part of it may reverse.
quotes: Generated $2.8 billion of cash from operating activities, net of working capital impacts of $565 million; reported third quarter Free Cash Flow3 of $1.9 billion

Working capital is expected to remain variable through the remainder of the year, as unfavorable accounts receivable and payable movements realized in the third quarter may partially reverse in future periods as production, shipment and collection patterns normalize.

financial_health.claim: Cash flow depends on metal prices, and the company does not hedge. The average realized gold price was $4,317 in the third quarter versus $3,539 a year earlier ($4,546 year to date). The guidance sensitivity table shows $505 (table in millions) of revenue and cost impact for a $100 change in gold.
quotes: Any decline in our realized prices adversely impacts our revenues, net income and operating cash flows, particularly in light of our strategy of not engaging in hedging transactions with respect to sales of gold, copper, silver, lead or zinc.

financial_health.basis: stated in the cash flow statement footnote (F3)
financial_health.claim: Cash taxes took a larger share of cash flow. Cash payments for income and mining taxes, net of refunds, were $3,207 year to date versus $1,701 a year earlier.
quotes: Includes $3,207 and $1,701 of cash payments for income and mining taxes, net of refunds, for the nine months ended September 30, 2026 and 2025, respectively.

financial_health.basis: inferred from comparing the F2 and F3 line items
financial_health.claim: Reported earnings include equity income that is only partly received as cash. Equity income of affiliates was 496 year to date, while return of investment from equity method investees was 137 (table in millions).

financial_health.basis: stated in F3; remaining authorization stated in P6
financial_health.claim: Most free cash flow goes to shareholders, which is discretionary. Year-to-date repurchases of common stock were (5,241) and dividends paid (831). Net financing outflow was (6,409), yet cash and restricted cash still rose by 1,192 (table in millions).
quotes: $2.8 billion remains under the current authorized program of $6.0 billion5

financial_health.basis: inferred from the balance sheet layout (F1) and liquidity disclosure (P6)
financial_health.claim: No debt maturity schedule is in the packet. The balance sheet shows Debt only as a non-current line of 5,087 (table in millions), with no separate current-debt line. Near-term repayment pressure therefore cannot be measured, but cash and the revolver are the stated sources to meet any maturities.

financial_health.basis: stated in P4 and P6; coverage by cash is inferred
financial_health.claim: A large cash call is coming. The amended Nevada Gold Mines agreement requires a $1.95 billion cash contribution within 30 days after the Fourmile contribution, which is expected in the fourth quarter. Fourth-quarter guidance also shows sustaining capital of $600 and development capital of $520 (table in millions), which the company says will be the year's highest.
quotes: The Company also agreed to contribute $1.95 billion in cash within 30 days following the contribution of the Fourmile development property.

financial_health.basis: stated in the guidance table and text (P6)
financial_health.claim: Management guides to higher unit costs in the fourth quarter, which could weigh on cash margins. Gold by-product AISC is guided at $1,900 per ounce for the fourth quarter versus $1,520 for the full year.
quotes: Although Newmont's full-year cost guidance has improved, unit costs are expected to increase in the fourth quarter primarily due to higher sustaining capital spend, as well as lower co-product volumes.

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A, plus the no-hedging statement in the 10-K risk factors.
growth_thesis.claim: Higher realized gold prices are the main driver of revenue growth. Nine-month Sales were 19,788 against 15,851 a year earlier (table in millions), and the Q3 average realized gold price was $4,317 per ounce against $3,539.
quotes: largely reflecting higher average realized gold and silver prices partially offset by lower sales volumes for gold
particularly in light of our strategy of not engaging in hedging transactions with respect to sales of gold, copper, silver, lead or zinc

growth_thesis.basis: Sales figures and the guidance statement are stated in the cited items. That this limits silver growth is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Silver is a second price-driven contributor. Q3 silver Sales were 550 against 293, and nine-month silver Sales were 1,552 against 672 (table in millions). This depends on Peñasquito silver output holding up.
quotes: Notably, silver production at Peñasquito is expected to decline to approximately half of third quarter volume.

growth_thesis.basis: Share counts, EPS, repurchases and the remaining authorization are stated. The per-share amplification mechanism is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Per-share growth is amplified by share buybacks. Diluted weighted shares fell to 1,051 from 1,100 in Q3, and Q3 diluted EPS was $2.35 against $1.67. Nine-month repurchases were 5,241 against 1,875 (table in millions).
quotes: $2.8 billion remains under the current authorized program of $6.0 billion5

growth_thesis.basis: Cash flow figures and the cost outlook are stated. The link between them and capital returns is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: Cash generation supports growth. Nine-month operating cash flow was 9,477 against 6,713, while additions to property, plant and mine development were 2,216 against 2,227 (table in millions). Continuing this requires prices to hold and unit costs to stay contained.
quotes: Newmont expects unit costs to trend higher in 2027 reflecting inflation escalation above the 3 percent assumption incorporated for 2026 guidance

growth_thesis.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A. The earnings benefit beyond the one-time gain is not stated.
growth_thesis.claim: Equity income from affiliates is growing, and the amended Nevada Gold Mines agreement is a further step. Nine-month equity income was 496 against 250 (table in millions). The company agreed to put in $1.95 billion in cash and expects a gain on completion, in Q4 2026.
quotes: The company also agreed to contribute $1.95 billion in cash within 30 days following the contribution of the Fourmile development property.
As Fiberline and Mike have no carrying value prior to their contribution, the Company expects to recognize a gain upon completion of the transaction.

growth_thesis.basis: Project milestones and production data are stated. Their contribution to growth is inferred.
growth_thesis.claim: New projects are the volume pipeline. Ahafo North produced 199 (koz) year to date, Tanami Expansion 2 is expected to reach commercial production in the first half of 2027, and the Red Chris Block Cave investment decision is targeted for early 2027. These depend on development capital of $1.4 billion in 2026 and on project execution.
quotes: Advancing the Red Chris Block Cave towards a full-funds investment decision in early 2027

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-Q MD&A (P4) and the Q3 earnings release (P6)
material_events.claim: Newmont and Barrick amended the Nevada Gold Mines joint venture. Newmont agreed to contribute $1.95 billion in cash within 30 days after the Fourmile property is contributed. That contribution had not yet taken place at the 10-Q date.
quotes: The Company also agreed to contribute $1.95 billion in cash within 30 days following the contribution of the Fourmile development property.

material_events.claim: Operations at the Cadia mine were temporarily suspended after seismic activity was recorded near the operation.
quotes: operations at Cadia were temporarily suspended following seismic activity recorded near the operation on April 14, 2026

material_events.claim: Ghana's Parliament enacted legislation, effective early March 2026, replacing the fixed 5% gold royalty with a sliding scale of 5% to 12%. It also cut the Growth and Sustainability Levy to 1%, effective April 1, 2026.
quotes: Subsequently, the Parliament of Ghana enacted legislation, effective early March 2026, revising the royalty framework to a sliding-scale structure ranging from 5% to 12% of gold revenues, based on prevailing gold prices.

material_events.basis: stated in the 10-K MD&A (P3) for Yanacocha; the quarterly amounts are read from the release table (P6)
material_events.claim: Impairment charges were 779 (table in millions) in the fourth quarter of 2025 column and 842 for full-year 2025. The 10-K MD&A cites impairment charges, primarily at Yanacocha, as a partial offset to higher net income.
quotes: This increase was partially offset by the increase in Income and mining tax benefit (expense) and Impairment charges, primarily at Yanacocha.

risks.basis: The risk factor and sensitivity table are stated in the items; the sequential price decline is read from the quarterly table; the margin effect is inferred.
risks.claim: Newmont is unhedged and exposed to gold price falls: its average realized gold price fell each quarter of 2026, from $4,900 per ounce in Q1 to $4,317 in Q3. The company's sensitivity table shows a $100 per ounce gold move changing revenue and cost by $505 (table in millions).
quotes: Any decline in our realized prices adversely impacts our revenues, net income and operating cash flows, particularly in light of our strategy of not engaging in hedging transactions with respect to sales of gold, copper, silver, lead or zinc.

risks.basis: Stated in the earnings release; the margin implication is inferred.
risks.claim: Unit costs are guided to rise in Q4 2026: Q4 gold by-product AISC guidance is $1,900 per ounce against $1,454 in Q3. Management also cites inflation, oil, royalty and foreign exchange pressures into 2027.
quotes: Although Newmont's full-year cost guidance has improved, unit costs are expected to increase in the fourth quarter primarily due to higher sustaining capital spend, as well as lower co-product volumes.

risks.basis: Stated in the 10-Q MD&A; the cost magnitude is not given.
risks.claim: Ghana's fiscal regime has tightened. A sliding-scale gold royalty of 5% to 12% replaced the earlier flat rate, and the company says Ghanaian costs could rise, especially when gold prices are high.
quotes: The revised royalty framework and changes to the GSL could increase the Company’s operating costs at its Ghanaian operations, particularly during periods of higher gold prices.

risks.basis: Dispute and amendment are stated in the items; recurrence risk is inferred.
risks.claim: The Nevada Gold Mines joint venture with Barrick has been a source of dispute, and Newmont has now committed $1.95 billion in cash to contribute development properties. Newmont had sent a notice of default earlier in 2026, so governance friction or execution slippage could recur.
quotes: On February 3, 2026, we sent Barrick a notice of default under the Nevada JV Agreement related to this conduct.
resolves all outstanding disputes between the Company and Barrick relating to NGM

risks.basis: Suspension is stated in the 10-Q; production figures are from the release table (koz); the recurrence risk is inferred.

quotes: operations at Cadia were temporarily suspended following seismic activity recorded near the operation on April 14, 2026

risks.basis: Guidance figures are stated; the shortfall risk is inferred from the Q3 to Q4 gap.

quotes: Newmont remains on track to meet its previously published 2026 production and capital guidance.

risks.basis: Liability amount and study uncertainty are stated; the size of any revision is not given.

quotes: Future material increases or decreases to the asset retirement obligation could occur as additional analyses are completed and further refinements to water quality and volume modeling are completed.

risks.basis: Cash flows and balances are stated; the stress scenario is inferred and judged low.

quotes: Working capital is expected to remain variable through the remainder of the year, as unfavorable accounts receivable and payable movements realized in the third quarter may partially reverse in future periods as production, shipment and collection patterns normalize.

unresolved_questions.basis: inferred. The adjustment line and cash taxes are stated, but the explanation is in omitted notes.
